sentences.text:
By way this application under Section 439(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the petitioner - org.
complainant seeks to challenge the order dated 27/08/2021 passed in CR.MA No.14663 of 2021 granting anticipatory bail to the respondent no.2 - org. accused on a condition viz., condition no.9(g)
asking the respondent no.2 - org. accused to file an undertaking before the concerned trial Court to the effect that he shall deposit the remaining amount of Rs.5,00,000/- within a period of 20 days and Rs.20,00,000/- within a period of 5 months thereafter.

2. The short facts of the case are that FIR being CR No.11195015210414 came to be registered before the Danta Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471,
120(B) and 34 of the Indian Penal Code against the org.

sentences.text: 1 forged NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/8794/2022 ORDER DATED: 17/01/2024 undefined and bogus documents were created by the accused persons for giving appointments / job in the government institutes and for that they have pocketed the huge sum of Rs.79,11,000/- from the victim.
2.1 Upon filing of FIR, the respondent no.2 preferred an application seeking anticipatory bail being CR.MA No.12653 of 2021 which came to be withdrawn as per order dated 23/07/2021.

Thereafter,
respondent no.2 had preferred an application being CR.MA No.14663 of 2021 seeking anticipatory bail seeking parity on the ground of release of other accused and on the ground of showing willingness to deposit the sum of Rs.25.00 lakh.
The co-ordinate Bench of this court considering such request has passed the order granting anticipatory bail to the respondent no.2 by imposing condition as stated in paragraph 1 of this order.

3. Since after release on anticipatory bail, respondent no.2 has not complied with the condition imposed by this Hon'ble Court, the petitioner has preferred this application seeking cancellation of the bail granted to the accused.
4. Learned Advocate for the petitioner has mainly contended that respondent no.2 neither abide by the specific condition imposed as aforesaid; nor filed any undertaking to that effect.

He would further submit that as on today more than two years have been passed after passing of such order granting anticipatory bail, not a single penny has been deposited by the respondent no.2 and thus there is a specific breach of condition imposed by the Hon'ble Court.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/8794/2022 ORDER DATED: 17/01/2024 undefined 5.

Learned Advocate for the petitioner has invited attention of this Court to the order dated 15/12/2022 whereby this Court has issued the bailable warrant in the sum of Rs.10,000/- against the respondent no.2 herein; however respondent no.2 did not appear before this Court in spite of service of warrant which in respectful submission of the petitioner shows total disregard to the order passed by this Court and therefore the bail granted to the respondent no.2 may be cancelled and respondent no.2 may be ordered to take in judicial custody with immediate effect.

6. Learned APP appearing for the State would submit that considering the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly, when the respondent no.2 has failed to comply with the condition imposed while granting anticipatory bail and failed to remain present before this Court pursuant to bailable warrant issued by this Court, the bail granted to the respondent no.2 ought to have been cancelled.
7. Having heard the learned Advocate for the petitioner and learned APP, it is an undisputed fact that while enlarging the respondent no.2 on anticipatory bail, this Court has specifically imposed condition no.9(g) as stated in paragraph 1 of this order and till date it has not been complied with.
To be noted that, taking such aspect of the matter, the co-ordinate Bench of this Court has passed an order dated 15/12/2022 issuing bailable warrant against respondent no.2 and though it was served upon respondent no.2, he opted not to appear before the Court.

. It also appears from the record that as per last order dated 01/08/2023 passed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court, a specific report was called for about any amount is deposited by the respondent no.2 or not and as per report of the learned Principal Sr. Civil Judge, Danta dated 05/08/2023, the respondent no.2 has not deposited any amount before this Court.
Thus, the respondent no.2 has shown total disregard to the order/s passed by this Court which lead to this Court to cancel the anticipatory bail granted by this Court.
9. For the foregoing reasons, the present petition is allowed.
The anticipatory bail granted to the respondent no.2 - accused as per order dated 27/08/2021 passed in CR.MA No.14663 of 2021 stands cacelled.
Respondent no.2 is ordered to surrender himself before the Jail authority concenred immediately.
Failure to do so, concerned PI is directed to secure his presence by arresting him.
The SP concerned is also directed to supervise the proceeding for securing presence of the respondent No.2- accused.
Learned APP to forward the copy of this order to SP concerned for compliance of the direction given by this Court.
Direct Service is permitted.
